Construction of In Vitro-In Vivo Correlation (IVIVC) Degradation Evaluation Model of Absorbable PCL/β-TCP Alveolar Bone Repair Scaffold and Exploration of a Biosafety Evaluation Idea Based on “Homeostasis”

Medium AM Biomedical Materials openalex Transferable Skim only in_vitro Exp. validation
Meng Zhong, 周志强, Changmei Niu, Xi Yang, Yang Li et al. Regenerative Biomaterials 2026-08-14 10.1093/rb/rbag176
单位: Sichuan University College of Biomedical Engineering, , Chengdu 610064, Sichuan,
通讯: Yang Li @ Sichuan University State Key Laboratory of Oral Diseases, National Center for Stomatology & National Clinical Research C  |  Tun Yuan @ Sichuan Testing Center for Biomaterials and Medical Devices Co., Ltd . Chengdu 610064, Sichuan,
相关性: 该论文研究了可吸收PCL/β-TCP骨修复支架的降解与体内外相关性，虽未涉及金属植入物或应力遮挡，但其降解-力学性能关联和长期稳定性评估方法对生物医用增材制造材料的性能验证具有参考价值。
边界: This paper does not address metallic implants, stress shielding, stiffness matching, or fatigue testing; it focuses on polymer-ceramic scaffold degradation and biosafety evaluation.
动机· 传统体内降解评估周期长、成本高，缺乏稳态标准。
方法· 建立多阶段体外加速降解与体内植入的IVIVC模型，覆盖25个月。
结果· 发现三阶段降解模式，支架维持力学支撑18个月，并识别出安全风险峰。
验证· 结合体外加速降解实验与体内植入数据验证模型。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· The study aims to overcome the limitations of traditional in vivo degradation assessments for resorbable medical devices, which are time-consuming, costly, and lack steady-state criteria.
Method· An in vitro-in vivo correlation (IVIVC) model was developed by correlating multi-stage accelerated in vitro degradation with in vivo implantation over a 25-month timeline for a 3D-printed PCL/β-TCP scaffold.
Result· A three-phase degradation pattern was identified, with the scaffold maintaining mechanical support for 18 months and showing excellent osseointegration, while a 'risk peak' in safety and functionality was detected.
Validation· The model was validated by comparing in vitro accelerated degradation data with in vivo implantation outcomes, including mechanical and histological assessments.

相关性: 该论文提出了一种用于流固耦合问题的降阶模型，其方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但未涉及植入物或生物医学应用。
边界: This paper does not address implant mechanics, biomechanical context, or FEA surrogate modeling for biomedical applications; it focuses on sloshing dynamics with flexible baffles.
动机· 研究柔性防晃挡板对液舱晃荡阻尼的影响，并开发高效预测工具。
方法· 采用双向分区FSI方法（FEM+FVM+VOF），并构建声-结构降阶模型预测频率偏移。
结果· 降阶模型与全阶模拟误差约4%，柔性挡板可增强涡旋形成并提升阻尼性能。
验证· 通过数值衰减试验和全阶FSI模拟对比验证降阶模型精度。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· The study aims to investigate the influence of flexible anti-sloshing devices on damping performance and to develop a computationally efficient tool for predicting frequency shifts.
Method· A two-way partitioned FSI framework combining finite element and finite volume methods with VOF is used, and a reduced-order acoustic-structural model is proposed for rapid frequency prediction.
Result· The reduced-order model achieves a maximum relative error of about 4% against full-order simulations, and flexible baffles enhance vortex formation and damping efficiency.
Validation· Validation is performed through numerical decay tests and comparison with full-order FSI simulations.

单位: School of Food and Environmental Engineering, Chuzhou Vocational and Technical College, Chuzhou, China
通讯: Yangyang Liu @ School of Engineering, Anhui Agricultural University, Hefei, China
相关性: 该论文将机器学习代理模型与优化算法结合用于材料参数识别，其方法可迁移至植入物力学仿真中的参数标定与代理建模。
边界: This paper does not address implant or biomechanics design, lacks uncertainty quantification, and focuses on fruit tissue rather than bone-implant systems.
动机· 传统水果组织力学测试破坏性强且耗时，需高效参数识别方法。
方法· 结合实验、有限元与混合机器学习代理模型，并用增强遗传算法求解参数识别问题。
结果· 代理模型平均绝对百分比误差最低0.05，力-位移曲线误差小于0.08。
验证· 通过黄冠梨压缩实验验证模型预测精度。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· Traditional destructive testing of fruit tissue is time-consuming and cannot capture mechanical responses under loading, necessitating an efficient parameter identification approach.
Method· The study integrates experimental compression tests, finite element analysis, and a hybrid machine learning surrogate model combining convolutional layers and attention-based bidirectional LSTM, with an enhanced genetic algorithm for parameter identification.
Result· The surrogate model achieves a minimum mean absolute percentage error of 0.05, and force-displacement predictions match experimental data with errors below 0.08.
Validation· The framework is validated through compression tests on Huangguan pears, demonstrating high predictive accuracy and reduced need for extensive physical testing.

通讯: Leonard Azamfirei @ Faculty of Medicine, George Emil Palade University of Medicine, Pharmacy, Science, and Technology of Targu Mures, 540142
相关性: 该论文研究了PLA支架的降解与力学性能演变，虽非金属植入物，但其对多孔结构-性能关系的分析方法可迁移至AM生物医学植入物的设计。
边界: This paper does not cover LPBF fabrication, metal implants, stress shielding, fatigue, or osseointegration; it focuses on polymer scaffolds and static compressive properties during degradation.
动机· 探究仿生与力学性能在骨组织支架设计中的权衡。
方法· 对比3D打印立方与螺旋二十四面体PLA支架，在动态培养基中降解21天，进行力学测试与建模。
结果· 立方支架初始模量与强度更高，但螺旋支架降解更快，力学性能下降更显著。
验证· 通过体外降解实验和残余性能模型验证。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· The study aims to investigate the trade-off between biomimetic architecture and mechanical competence in bone tissue engineering scaffolds.
Method· Two types of 3D-printed PLA scaffolds (cubic and gyroid TPMS) were immersed in a protein-rich medium under dynamic conditions at 37°C for 21 days, followed by mechanical characterization and analytical modeling.
Result· Cubic scaffolds showed higher initial compressive modulus and strength, while gyroid scaffolds exhibited faster mass loss and structural deterioration, leading to a more pronounced reduction in mechanical properties.
Validation· The experimental degradation data were compared with predictions from the Residual Property Model, which accurately captured cubic but not gyroid behavior.

动机· 提高多级载荷下疲劳寿命预测精度，考虑载荷顺序效应。
方法· 将改进的非线性损伤累积模型嵌入神经网络损失函数，构建PINN，并设计输入层数据结构处理变载荷级数。

Result· The proposed PINN demonstrated higher prediction accuracy and broader applicability compared to purely data-driven models and PINNs based on other damage models.
Validation· The model was trained and validated using fatigue test data under loading sequences with different numbers of levels.

边界: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or stress shielding; it focuses on waveform design in inkjet printing with physical experiments.
动机· 解决压电喷墨打印中高维、稀疏可行域且带物理约束的波形设计难题。
方法· 提出分类器辅助的多信任域贝叶斯优化架构，用随机森林分类器作为安全门控，并引入多信任域并行探索。

Motivation· The paper addresses the challenge of designing multi-pulse driving waveforms for piezoelectric inkjet printing, which is a constrained, high-dimensional black-box optimization problem with a sparse feasible region.
Method· It proposes a classifier-assisted multi-trust-region Bayesian optimization (CA-TuRBO-m) that uses a random forest classifier as a safety gate and a multi-trust-region mechanism to balance exploration and exploitation.
Result· The method achieves an average of 3.8 invalid prints out of 200 online iterations, a 98.1% effective sampling rate, and enables multi-target adaptive control without complex fluid dynamics models.

Motivation· Traditional explicit finite difference methods are constrained by the CFL stability criterion, limiting computational speed for high-order spatial discretizations.
Method· The Virtual Kinetic Network (VKN) reformulates elliptic PDEs into a critically damped second-order hyperbolic system with virtual mass and damping, achieving unconditional stability.
Result· VKN demonstrates stability at large time steps and a 5.0x speedup over 6th-order FDM across seven benchmark regimes, enabling real-time digital twin applications.
Validation· Validation is performed through numerical benchmarks on standard PDE problems, with no experimental or biomedical validation.

Motivation· To identify preoperative predictors for the need of femoral soft-tissue releases during direct anterior approach total hip arthroplasty.

Motivation· Exact Bayesian online learning is computationally prohibitive, so it is crucial to understand when approximate posteriors preserve the statistical guarantees of exact inference.

Result· Approximate posterior methods that track the exact posterior sufficiently well achieve the same fast regret rates as exact Bayes, with reduced computational overhead.

动机· 传统有限元难以高效模拟多尺度路面退化，需实时预测。
方法· 构建三个耦合神经网络，嵌入细观断裂与粘弹性本构，用热力学约束损失训练。

Motivation· Conventional finite element approaches are computationally impractical for integrating mesoscale material degradation with macroscale structural response in asphalt pavement, necessitating a more efficient predictive framework.
Method· MesoPINN-Pave employs three interconnected neural networks—a mesoscale surrogate trained on XFEM fracture simulations, a macroscale stress-strain predictor, and a coupling network—with thermodynamically constrained loss functions embedding viscoelastic PDE residuals and cohesive zone evolution.
Result· The framework achieved a 4.8% mean absolute error in fatigue life prediction and a 1,200-fold speedup over full multi-scale finite element simulation, with robust generalization across climate zones (R² > 0.87).
Validation· Validation was performed against Long-Term Pavement Performance (LTPP) data and field falling weight deflectometer measurements, including leave-one-climate-out testing.

相关性: 该论文提出了一种用于物理信息神经网络的主动采样策略，可提高求解PDE的效率，对FEA代理模型的训练采样优化具有参考价值，但未涉及生物力学或植入物设计。
边界: This paper does not address implant/biomechanics design, lacks uncertainty quantification, and does not handle constraints or multi-objective optimization in the context of FEA surrogate modeling.
动机· 提高PINN求解PDE的精度，通过优化配点采样策略。
方法· 提出时空组合主动采样，筛选固定规则并组合成计划，带安全锚定。
结果· 在18个二维泊松任务上平均误差降低12.8%，优于固定计划。

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To improve the accuracy of physics-informed neural networks for solving PDEs by optimizing the distribution and update of collocation points.
Method· Proposes a spatiotemporal compositional active sampling (STCAS) protocol that screens fixed sampling rules, forms a shortlist, and evaluates blended plans with a safety anchor.
Result· On 18 two-dimensional Poisson tasks, STCAS reduces aggregate relative-L2 error by 12.8% compared to standard PINN, and outperforms compared methods on transfer tasks.
Validation· Validated on analytically specified 2D Poisson problems and two transfer tasks (convection-diffusion and Burgers equations) using numerical benchmarks.

相关性: 该论文主要关注双曲平衡律的贝叶斯反馈控制，与AM生物医学材料方向关联较弱，仅最后提及LPBF功率调节的反馈模型。
边界: This paper does not address porous structure, stress shielding, mechanical testing, fatigue, or osseointegration; it focuses on control theory for hyperbolic PDEs with only a tangential mention of LPBF.
动机· 为双曲平衡律设计鲁棒的反馈控制方法，并扩展到非线性与随机问题。
方法· 提出贝叶斯框架，利用Lyapunov衰减估计作为似然传播反馈参数分布。
结果· 在多个线性和非线性系统上验证了稳定性域，并展示了向LPBF功率调节模型的迁移。

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To develop a robust feedback control framework for hyperbolic balance laws that can handle nonlinear and stochastic regimes where analytical methods are limited.
Method· A Bayesian approach is introduced that propagates a probability distribution over feedback parameters using Lyapunov decay estimates as a likelihood, combined with first-order local Lax-Friedrichs discretizations.
Result· The method reproduces known stability intervals for linear systems and infers robust stability domains for nonlinear and stochastic problems, including a transfer to a two-parameter feedback model for laser powder bed fusion.
Validation· Validation is performed through numerical benchmarks on wave, Saint-Venant, and Burgers equations, with no experimental or mechanical testing.

Motivation· Existing human-machine interaction methods for machining equipment lack specificity and efficiency, necessitating a more adaptive and integrated approach.

Result· Total and device costs continued pre-existing downward trends post-DRG, with no significant slope changes in the primary analysis, though sensitivity analysis excluding 2020 showed a significant post-DRG slope change for total cost.
Validation· Validation included multiple sensitivity analyses (CPI adjustment, COVID-19 exclusion, AR(1) correction, case-mix adjustment) and a composite adverse discharge outcome comparison.

Motivation· To characterize the mechanical behavior of SLM-fabricated tungsten alloys under extreme loading conditions for shaped charge liner applications.
Method· Quasi-static and dynamic tests were conducted using a universal testing machine and split Hopkinson pressure bar, and a Johnson-Cook constitutive model was calibrated.
Result· The 84W alloy liner produced a well-formed jet with 87 mm penetration depth and 5101.5 m/s tip velocity, and simulations matched experiments within 9.19% deviation.
Validation· The model was validated via pulsed X-ray diagnostics and static penetration tests.

边界: This paper does not quantify stress shielding, micromotion, or any biomechanical outcomes; it is a clinical meta-analysis on surgeon volume, with no FE modeling, implant design, or patient-specific biomechanics.
动机· 探究外科医生手术量对全髋关节置换术后结局的影响。
方法· 系统综述和荟萃分析，检索Medline和Embase，纳入18项研究。

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To synthesize evidence on the association between surgeon volume and outcomes after primary total hip arthroplasty.
Method· A PRISMA-guided systematic review and meta-analysis of 18 studies involving 796,061 patients, with thresholds for surgeon volume defined variably across studies.
Result· High-volume surgeons were associated with significantly lower 1-month readmission and 3-month mortality, but no significant differences in revision rates were found.
Validation· The review included high-quality clinical studies and pooled outcomes using meta-analytic methods.
